explanation.en:
間 (かん) is used to say how long an action continues. It means “for” or “during” a period of time. You put 間 after a time amount to show duration.

Key points:
• Time + 間 = duration: 2時間, 3日間
• Use it with actions that last: 勉強します, 休みます, 仕事します
• It answers “how long?” not “when?”
• For minutes and hours, 間 is common and clear

Example: “二時間勉強します” means “I study for two hours.” “三日間日本にいます” means “I will be in Japan for three days.”

Be careful: に marks a point in time, while 間 shows duration. “七時に起きます” (at 7) is different from “七時間勉強します” (study for 7 hours).

You can also use 間 with days or weeks to show a period: 一週間, 二週間, 三日間. It is a simple way to talk about how long you do something.

Practice by making sentences about your day: 勉強, 仕事, 休み, 旅行, and add a duration with 間.

examples.english: I will be in Japan for three days.
I will rest for one week.
I will wait for five minutes.

commonMistakes.correction: Use 間 to show how long
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 二時間に勉強します → ✅ 二時間勉強します

commonMistakes.correction: Add 間 for a clear duration
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 三日日本にいます → ✅ 三日間日本にいます
